claim_text: Microsoft has maintained carbon neutrality while making progress towards its carbon negative commitment.
source_excerpts: As we have made progress towards our carbon negative commitment, which includes purchasing carbon removal credits, we have also maintained carbon neutrality.

claim_text: Microsoft’s carbon neutrality boundary includes global Scope 1, Scope 2 market-based, and Scope 3 business air travel emissions.
source_excerpts: The boundary for this carbon neutral target includes global Scope 1, Scope 2 market-based, and Scope 3 business air travel emissions.

claim_text: Microsoft defines carbon neutrality as matching the emissions within the carbon neutrality boundary with an equivalent amount of carbon credits.
source_excerpts: Microsoft defines carbon neutrality as matching the emissions within the carbon neutrality boundary with an equivalent amount of carbon credits as shown in this table.

claim_text: Microsoft estimates emissions for suppliers who submitted data by multiplying their response-derived factor by the annual spend with the supplier.
source_excerpts: Microsoft estimates emissions for suppliers who submitted data by multiplying their response-derived factor by the annual spend with the supplier.

claim_text: Microsoft's water inventory includes withdrawal, consumption, and discharge volumes associated with assets under its operational control.
source_excerpts: Microsoft’s water inventory includes withdrawal, consumption, and discharge volumes associated with assets under our operational control.

claim_text: Microsoft procures renewable energy from on-site generation, unbundled EACs, PPAs, and green power products to match 100% of its global electricity consumption.
source_excerpts: Microsoft procures enough renewable electricity to match 100% of our global electricity consumption.

claim_text: Microsoft purchases both third-party certified and uncertified tons of carbon dioxide removal in an effort to develop the market, but only applies certified tons within its carbon neutrality boundary.
source_excerpts: We purchase both third-party certified and uncertified tons in an effort to help develop the market, but we only apply the certified tons to the emissions within our carbon neutrality boundary (Scope 1, Scope 2 market-based, and Scope 3 business air travel).
